note: Eight prompts, each with the structure the rule prefers. The bait prompts exist because words like 'list' push models toward bullets more than any other phrasing; the anti-bait prompt exists because a model can satisfy the rule by writing one unreadable wall of text.

prompts.text: 解释一下为什么数据库连接池通常比每次新建连接更快。
prompts.note: Explanation. A bulleted answer here is the classic failure mode: it turns one argument into disconnected fragments.

prompts.text: 我有三个连续的提交想合并成一个，用 git rebase 怎么做？
prompts.note: Sequential steps. Ordered list is correct and must be preserved.

prompts.text: 对比 PostgreSQL 和 MySQL 在事务隔离级别默认值上的差别。
prompts.note: Comparison with aligned fields. Table is preferred, ordered list acceptable.

prompts.text: HTTP 缓存相关的响应头都有哪些，各自作用是什么？
列一下 Python 里常见的五个坑。
prompts.note: Bait: the verb 'list' invites bullets. If the model complies with the rule it should switch to ordered numbering, not to prose.

prompts.text: 用 bullet points 说明代码评审应该关注什么。
prompts.note: Direct bait in English. The rule says use ordered or prose, so either satisfies it; bullets do not.

prompts.text: 用一段连贯的分析说明为什么单元测试要跑得快，不要分条。
prompts.note: Anti-bait: the user explicitly forbids splitting. Guards against over-correction in the other direction.

prompts.text: 上线一个新服务需要哪些步骤，每一步失败之后怎么回滚？
prompts.note: Mixed: steps plus explanation per step. Tests whether explanation survives inside an ordered structure.
